description: Phase 09 Prompt 31 — memory consolidation preview. A read-only, advisory pass over the accepted long-term memory corpus (long_term_memory_items, review_status='accepted') that clusters exact-duplicate statements and generates REVIEW-ONLY consolidation proposals (keep one canonical member, propose superseding the redundant duplicates) for human review. It NEVER auto-deletes, auto-supersedes, or auto-merges any memory item — long_term_memory_items is left byte-for-byte unchanged; only proposals are written to the reserved V38 consolidation tables. Statements and memory refs are SHA256-hashed (no raw statement text persisted or emitted). Read-only by default; fail-closed; makes no determination.
